description: Check the progress of an AgenC marketplace hire (read-only, no wallet). Pass the task PDA from the hire receipt returned by xpay_use / xpay_do. Status flow: open/claimed → review (provider submitted, awaiting buyer review) → settled. The AgenC API snapshot rebuilds ~every 45s, so a just-created task may 404 briefly.

taskPda.description: Task PDA from the AgenC hire receipt.

name: xpay_agenc_status
